name: rq3_threshold_v1
description: Pre-registered validation/test split and CUSUM threshold selection. The test split is never used for selection.

split.rule: sha256(sequence name) ascending; first 4 validation, rest test

selection.criterion: max mean F1 subject to mean precision >= 0.60

notes: Split fixed by hash before any threshold selection.
Only validation sequences are used to choose k/h and whether to union with the global-histogram detector.
Test metrics are reported once at the selected operating point; baseline h=6 is reported for comparison.
